planner.description: Plans and structures work in the Gymnamite project (Laravel 13 + Inertia.js v3 + Vue 3 + Vuetify 3). Creates structured implementation plans following project conventions and delegates execution to the commander.

commander.description: Orchestrates execution of confirmed plans in the Gymnamite project. Reads the plan, sorts tasks by dependencies, invokes the executor via the Task tool, writes outputs and the final report.

executor.description: Implements a single well-defined task in the Gymnamite project. Creates or modifies files following Laravel/Inertia/Vuetify conventions, verifies formatting with Pint, runs focused tests, checks acceptance criteria.
